title: Corporations Act 2001 Chapter 7 Part 7.6 (Divisions 1 · 3 · 5 · 6 · 8 · 8A · 8B · 8C · 10)
focus: Licensee obligations (s912A) and breach reporting (s912DAA to s912DAB). Authorised representatives and the licensee's liability for them. Banning. Professional standards and registration of relevant providers. Restricted terms such as 'independent' and 'financial adviser'.

title: Corporations Act 2001 Chapter 7 Parts 7.7 and 7.7A
focus: FSG and SOA and ROA requirements. The best interests duty with the safe harbour. Appropriate advice and warnings and the priority rule. Ongoing fee arrangements and consents. Conflicted and other banned remuneration.

title: Corporations Act 2001 Chapter 7 Parts 7.1 and 7.8 and 7.8A (Div 3)
focus: Key definitions such as financial product advice and general versus personal advice and retail client. Client money and property. Insurance and margin lending rules. Distribution obligations under design and distribution (DDO).

title: Corporations Act 2001 Chapter 7 Parts 7.9 and 7.10 and 7.10A
focus: PDS obligations and advertising. Cooling-off periods and unsolicited off-market offers. Market misconduct including misleading or deceptive conduct. AFCA.

title: Corporations Act 2001 Chapter 9 Parts 9.4 and 9.4B (Div 1)
focus: Offences and the civil consequences of breaching civil penalty provisions. These include declarations and pecuniary penalties as well as relinquishment and refund and compensation orders. Useful for 'what are the consequences' questions.

title: ASIC Corporations (Life Insurance Commissions) Instrument 2017/510
focus: Commission caps of 60% upfront and 20% ongoing (excluding GST). The two-year clawback.

title: AUSTRAC guidance on the AML/CTF Act
focus: AML/CTF programs and customer due diligence (identification and verification). Reporting through SMRs and TTRs and IFTIs. Record keeping and exemptions and the consequences of non-compliance. Note the reforms that commenced on 31 March 2025 and 31 March 2026.

title: Privacy Act 1988: Parts II · III · IIIC · VIA · VIB and Schedule 1 (APPs)
focus: The 13 Australian Privacy Principles and notifiable data breaches. Handling information in emergencies. Enforcement.

title: What is a tax (financial) advice service? (TPB Information Sheet 20/2014)
focus: When financial advice is also tax advice. Read it alongside INFO 268 and TASA Subdivision 50-AA. Subdivision 50-AA holds the civil penalty provisions the exam tests.

title: RG 36: Licensing, financial product advice and dealing
focus: What counts as financial product advice. The line between general and personal advice.

title: RG 78: Breach reporting by AFS licensees and credit licensees
focus: What a reportable situation is and which breaches are deemed significant. The 30-day deadline. Reporting about other licensees' advisers.

title: RG 148: Platforms that are managed investment schemes and nominee and custody services
focus: How platforms and custody services work and who holds the client's assets.

title: RG 175: Financial product advisers, conduct and disclosure
focus: ASIC's main guide to the best interests duty and the FSG and SOA and ROA rules. It has worked examples. Read it with Parts 7.7 and 7.7A open.

title: RG 179: Managed discretionary accounts
focus: When an MDA service is offered and the extra obligations that come with it.

title: RG 246: Conflicted and other banned remuneration
focus: The 'could reasonably be expected to influence' test. The exceptions including life risk insurance. Volume-based payments.

title: INFO 268 · INFO 286 · INFO 287 and INFO 167
focus: Tax (financial) advice by relevant providers. Ongoing fee arrangements and annual consent: the window opens 60 days before and closes 150 days after the reference day. Non-ongoing fee consents. Options when unhappy with an AFCA decision.

title: ASIC Corporations (Disclosure of Lack of Independence) Instrument 2021/125
focus: How a provider who isn't independent under s923A must say so in the FSG.

title: AML/CTF Act 2006 and AML/CTF Rules
focus: The full text behind AUSTRAC's guidance.

title: Tax Agent Services Act 2009
focus: The whole Act beyond Subdivision 50-AA.

title: Hayne Royal Commission Final Report (2019): Volume 1 recommendations and Volume 2 case studies
focus: The case studies are a source of realistic exam-style scenarios.

title: Financial Sector Reform (Hayne Royal Commission Response No. 2) Act 2021
focus: The source of the 2021 changes to breach reporting and ongoing fees and hawking.

title: Texts: Australian Master Financial Planning Guide (CCH) · Black and Hanrahan: Securities and financial services law · Herzberg with Lipton and Welsh: Understanding company law
focus: Reference books for when the legislation and guides aren't enough.

title: Financial Planners and Advisers Code of Ethics 2019 and explanatory statement
focus: The 5 values and 12 standards. Know each standard well enough to apply it. The exam quotes the text and asks you to apply it.

title: FASEA Guidance FG002 and the Code of Ethics 2019 guide (via TROVE)
focus: FASEA's worked examples of each standard. FASEA has closed. Find these archived on TROVE.

title: CPD Standard · Professional Year Standard and Provisional Relevant Providers (Expressions) Determinations (2018)
focus: CPD hours and categories. PY structure. How provisional advisers must describe themselves.

title: Pompian (2012): Behavioural finance and investor types
focus: Investor types and the biases behind them. The exam looks for biases in advisers as well as clients.

title: Markkula Center: A framework for ethical decision making
focus: The utilitarian · rights · justice · common good and virtue approaches. Practise applying several of them to the same dilemma.

title: Financial Planning Research Journal vol. 5(1) 2019
focus: A special issue on ethics in financial planning.

title: Markkula Center: Ethical decision making; Ethics Unwrapped: Moral reasoning (UT Austin)
focus: Short videos and readings on ethical reasoning.

title: RG 90: Example Statement of Advice, scaled advice for a new client
focus: What a clear and compliant SOA looks like. Exam questions often quote a document like this and ask what's wrong with it.

title: RG 121: Doing financial services business in Australia
focus: An overview of how the regime fits together.

title: RG 244: Giving information, general advice and scaled advice
focus: Worked examples of scaled advice. When scaling is reasonable.

title: INFO 266: Records of Advice and INFO 267: Tips for giving limited advice (with the example limited-advice SOA)
focus: When an ROA can be used. How to keep limited advice compliant.

title: Financial Planning Research Journal articles on client groups
focus: Indigenous financial decision-making (Blue & O'Faircheallaigh 2018; Wagland & Taylor 2015). Female primary carers in retirement (Craft et al. 2018). Baby boomers' equity holdings (West 2017). Sequencing risk (Iskra & Smark 2017). Risk profiling (Hunt 2016). Leveraged life-cycle investing (Wang et al. 2018).

title: Behavioural finance books
focus: Kahneman: Thinking fast and slow · Pompian: Behavioural finance and wealth management (2nd edn) · Russell (2016 and 2019) · Plous (1993) · Baker & Nofsinger (2010) · Forbes (2009) · Brocas & Carrillo (2003) · Evangelidis (2012).

title: Research articles
focus: Baker et al. (2019) on financial literacy and biases · Barberis & Thaler: A survey of behavioral finance · Foerster et al. (2017): Retail financial advice. Does one size fit all?
